'''Four-way Laser Towers''' were armed towers found in in pairs within the [[Carbon-freezing chamber/Legends|Carbon-freezing chamber]] levels of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. A single tower could shoot out four [[Laser/Legends|lasers]] in opposite directions at a time.<ref name="SuperEMP" />
